title: Multi-PDF Chatbot
shortDescription: An AI-powered chatbot that allows users to upload multiple PDF documents and ask questions about their content.
fullDescription: Multi-PDF Chatbot is an AI application designed to make document analysis easier. Users can interact with multiple PDF files through natural language queries and receive relevant answers based on document content. The project demonstrates PDF processing, conversational AI, document retrieval, and language model integration.

title: SmartPresence
shortDescription: A smart university attendance management system designed to simplify and secure student attendance tracking.
fullDescription: SmartPresence is a university attendance management project focused on digitizing the attendance process. It aims to reduce manual work, improve attendance accuracy, and provide a more efficient way to manage student attendance records through modern software technologies.

title: URL Shortener
shortDescription: A containerised web application that converts long URLs into short, shareable links for easier access and sharing.
fullDescription: URL Shortener is a web development project designed to simplify long web addresses by generating shorter links. It demonstrates core concepts of URL processing, link redirection, and web application development.
